## Motivation

HY-Nomas (#46124) and FastH3 Omni (#45530) have public cookbooks but are missing from Supported Models. The realtime overview also omits the registered HY-Nomas and Cosmos-Dreams adapters and presents sliding-window controls as universal.

## Modifications

- Add HY-Nomas and FastH3 Omni catalog entries linked to their existing recipes.
- List all four registered realtime pipeline families and their control/cache boundaries.
- Link HY-Nomas cache configuration back to its cookbook instead of duplicating model-specific settings.

Two documentation files only, +22/-2. No README model sections, navigation/layout redesign, or runtime changes.

## Validation

- `pre-commit run --files docs/src/snippets/diffusion/model-catalog.jsx docs/docs/sglang-diffusion/realtime_models.mdx`
- `mint validate`
- `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`
- Playwright against the local Mintlify site: both catalog tabs/recipe links, FastH3 Omni and HY-Nomas cache anchors, all four realtime table rows, desktop/mobile screenshots, no page errors.
- Checked entries against the current model overlay and realtime adapter registries.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no runtime or model changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: no performance claims.

@@ -45,7 +49,8 @@ For the complete model list, see
 
 ## Causal Cache Controls
 
-Realtime requests can override two model defaults:
+Realtime requests expose two causal-cache overrides where supported by the
+model's adapter:
 
 - `realtime_causal_sink_size`: amount of stable prefix history retained as an attention sink
 - `realtime_causal_kv_cache_num_frames`: recent causal history retained in the rolling KV-cache window
@@ -54,6 +59,10 @@ Larger windows preserve more history but increase resident memory and attention
 work. These fields are request/session controls; supported ranges and defaults
 remain model-specific.
 
+These controls are not universal across realtime models. HY-Nomas uses an
+event-segment cache; follow its [cache settings](/cookbook/diffusion/HY-Nomas/HY-Nomas#kv-cache-budget)
+instead of applying sliding-window controls.
+
 For supported LingBot World deployments, the server-level
 `--kv-cache-quant {off,int4,int2}` option compresses completed cache chunks.
 It is disabled by default and is lossy when enabled. Start with `int4`; use
@@ -66,7 +75,8 @@ current limitations.

-sliding-window-and-sink path. It does not apply to SANA-WM realtime, LongLive 2.0
